probe1_translation_invariance.interpretation: If invariant, raw-vs-delta comparison is fair; delta-asymmetry objection falsified.

probe2_subsampling_power.interpretation: Low CV at operating n means the estimator is stable; power loss does not explain the null.

probe3_metric_blindspot.interpretation: Negative/zero correlation with the cell-level reference, or near-zero dynamic range, means the scalar metric is structurally blind.

probe4_magnitude_confound.interpretation: magnitude-only >= energy AND energy strongly explained by magnitude -> confound
